question: **Choose the incorrectly spelt word. **
solution:
The correct answer is "**Glovve**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, the word in option 2 is incorrectly spelled.
 
• **The word "Glovve" is incorrectly spelled as it contains an extra "v". **
 
• **The correct spelling of the word is "Glove".**
 
• "Glove" refers to a covering for the hand, usually made of cloth or leather.(दस्ताना)
 
 
• Example: He wore a pair of gloves to protect his hands from the cold.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "Wider", is spelled correctly and means having a greater width.(व्यापक)
 
• Option 3, "Hide", is spelled correctly and means to conceal or keep out of sight.(छिपाना)
 
• Option 4, "Fold", is spelled correctly and means to bend or crease something.(तह करना)
